basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Toronto, Canada, who recently dove into the world of cryptocurrency mining. By day, I'm an IT support specialist at a local startup, and by night, I'm either gaming or tweaking my mining rigs. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring the great outdoors or hanging out with friends over some craft beers. My Reddit activity is mostly in the evenings and late nights when I have some downtime. I'm still learning the ropes of Reddit, so I might come off as a bit of a newbie.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in IT for a few years. My interest in cryptocurrency started when a friend introduced me to EtherMining a few months ago. I've been self-learning through online forums and YouTube tutorials.
